initial_insulin_glucose_decline_mg_dl_hr.applies_when: active DKA, glucose >=250 mg/dL, insulin delivered, no dextrose, and glucose remains above the dextrose-transition threshold
initial_insulin_glucose_decline_mg_dl_hr.source: Umpierrez GE et al. Hyperglycemic Crises in Adults With Diabetes: A Consensus Report. Diabetes Care. 2024;47(8):1257-1275.
initial_insulin_glucose_decline_mg_dl_hr.role: broad protocol-response boundary, not patient-specific target

dka_resolution.source: Umpierrez GE et al. Hyperglycemic Crises in Adults With Diabetes: A Consensus Report. Diabetes Care. 2024;47(8):1257-1275.
dka_resolution.role: resolution boundary, not a fixed hourly acid-base slope

potassium_safety.source: Umpierrez GE et al. Hyperglycemic Crises in Adults With Diabetes: A Consensus Report. Diabetes Care. 2024;47(8):1257-1275.
potassium_safety.role: safety boundary, not a fitted potassium trajectory

simulated_deaths.interpretation: Deaths with presence evidence but no numeric dose are explicitly coverage-limited. No-evidence deaths may still reflect missing capture, but the demo cannot prove treatment occurred.

eicu_protocol_dose_response.warning: Descriptive only. Heterogeneous patient state, prior insulin, and unobserved co-treatment make this unsuitable as a hard source gate.

decision.stop_rule: Change a mechanism only when a sourced boundary and external falsification agree. Do not tune constants to minimize this cohort.
